Library

Every seed pack in the library, grouped by what it is for. A pack is a collection of Task Objects, the reusable things, and Tasks, the work an authorized worker can claim.

Every pack is a proposal: checked offline, and not installed, admitted or run by any worker.

The library in numbers

  • 80 packs
  • 1,520 Task Objects
  • 490 Task templates
  • 45 worked examples the library recomputes
  • 26 packs with code and tests

Counted from the library as it stood on October 31, 2026 · Source ↗

Every Task and Task Object was checked offline against Tessera’s own schemas. Record ↗

Code + tests The pack ships its own code with tests, which the library’s CI runs for that pack.
